lines.t: Eat of Me, partake of My words, and be filled! Breathe Me in, that the song of The Lamb may dwell within you! For it is the knowledge of My love, the revelation of who I truly am! - A song, a chorus, soon to be a symphony, a great outpouring of revelation to the praise of My glory!
Beloved, it is also the music we share,
Sweet melodies of grace and peace
Each string plucked gently and surely...
The sound of My love revealed
Bearing much fruit in The Beloved...
